song.name: Celestial Rebellion
song.plot: Seraphina takes leadership of the survivors and begins the rebellion against the remaining Void forces — the Queen of the Fallen rising beneath the astral eye.
song.analysis: Seraphina takes leadership of the survivors and begins the rebellion against the remaining Void forces. Full structure restored (kept song); light anchors grafted: Anya's fall, the echo of Seraphina's name, freeing the Warden, and the mandatory Era II nod — Queen of the Fallen (never the Era III title).

section.name: Verse 1
section.original: In the darkened void of heaven, where the silent cosmos cry, A tale of ancient warriors, who dared to touch the sky. With the fire of rebellion, and the courage to defy, They rose against the tyranny, beneath the astral eye.
section.reworked: In the darkened void of heaven, where the silent cosmos cry, Anya's gone to the shadows, but she touched the astral sky. With the fire of rebellion, and the courage to defy, They rose against the tyranny, beneath the astral eye.

section.name: Pre-Chorus
section.original: Through the chaos and the thunder, where the stars ignite the flame, We stand as one united, in the echo of our name.
section.reworked: Through the chaos and the thunder, where the stars ignite the flame, We stand as one united, in the echo of her name.

section.name: Chorus
section.original: In the Celestial Rebellion, where the shadows meet the light, We'll fight against the darkness, with the echo of our name, In the Celestial Rebellion, where the shadows meet the light, We’ll fight against the darkness, with the power of our might. Through the cosmic storm and fury, where the galaxies collide, In the Celestial Rebellion, our spirits will abide.
section.reworked: In the Celestial Rebellion, where the shadows meet the light, We'll fight against the darkness, in the echo of her name, In the Celestial Rebellion, where the shadows meet the light, We'll fight against the darkness, with the power of our might. Through the cosmic storm and fury, where the galaxies collide, The Queen of the Fallen rising, with nowhere left to hide.

section.name: Verse 2
section.original: From the ruins of the ancients, to the heights of distant stars, We gather strength and wisdom, in the battle scars. With the vision of the fearless, and the heart of endless night, We journey through the stardust, in the quest for what is right.
section.reworked: From the ruins of the ancients, to the heights of distant stars, We gather strength and wisdom, in the battle scars. With the vision of the fearless, and the heart of endless night, We march to free the Warden, in the quest for what is right.

section.name: Bridge
section.original: As the heavens quake and tremble, and the cosmos seem to fall, We hear the call to battle, we stand proud and tall. For in the darkest moments, our true nature is revealed, In the Celestial Rebellion, our fate is sealed.

section.name: Verse 3
section.original: When the final light has faded, and the shadows claim the skies, We’ll stand as one together, with fire in our eyes. For in the Celestial Rebellion, our spirits will be free, Through the shadows, we’ll rise victorious, our destiny to see.
